uiPage.title: UI elements
uiPage.intro: The general building blocks of PreLife — colors, typography, controls, cards and states in one place, all following the light single-tone capstone language.

sections.colorsDesc: One calm light tone across the platform, with each section carrying its own accent.
sections.typographyDesc: Geist everywhere — tracked caps for labels, tight bold for headlines.
sections.buttonsDesc: Pills throughout — the primary action is always a solid ink pill.
sections.badgesDesc: Section chips carry the capstone accents; status pills stay quiet.
sections.formsDesc: Calm inputs on the light tone, hairline borders, soft focus rings.
sections.cardsDesc: Rounded cards on the paper tone — tinted icon chips and clear hierarchy.
sections.avatarsDesc: Initials on the section tint — calm and consistent.
sections.tabsDesc: Pill tabs in the Ultrahuman spirit — the active tab is a solid ink pill.
sections.feedbackDesc: Progress, loading and messages that keep the tone quiet.

gymHome.metaDescription: Coach-built training plans, a precise exercise library, a weekly class schedule and a hand-picked directory of premium partner gyms.
gymHome.heroSubtitle: Coach-built training plans, a precise exercise library and the finest partner gyms — composed into one premium training experience.
gymHome.marqueeItems: Strength • Discipline • Power • Mobility • Recovery • Community
gymHome.whySubtitle: Training, recovery and nutrition composed as one system — not three separate apps.
gymHome.why1Desc: Every plan adjusts to your level, schedule and equipment — week by week.
gymHome.why2Desc: A movement library reviewed by certified strength coaches, with clear execution cues.
gymHome.why3Desc: Deload weeks, mobility flows and sleep guidance scheduled right beside your lifts.
gymHome.why4Desc: Macro targets that follow your training phase, so the kitchen matches the gym.
gymHome.plansTitle: Programs with a point of view
gymHome.plansSubtitle: Every plan is periodized by coaches — progressive, measurable and honest about the work it takes.
gymHome.planFoundationDesc: Build technique and base strength with a measured, full-body start.
gymHome.planHypertrophyDesc: Four focused sessions a week to add quality muscle and symmetry.
gymHome.planAthleticDesc: Intense circuits and intervals for power, speed and work capacity.
gymHome.exercisesSubtitle: Crisp, coach-verified technique notes for the movements that matter most.
gymHome.scheduleSubtitle: Drop-in classes are included with every plan — just pick a slot and show up.
gymHome.scheduleRestNote: Sunday is recovery day — guided mobility flows live in the Meditation module.
gymHome.storiesTitle: Results that keep people showing up
gymHome.stories1Quote: The hypertrophy plan finally made training feel structured. Twelve weeks in, my numbers moved — and so did my habits.
gymHome.stories2Quote: Technique notes are short and exact. My deadlift stopped hurting my back and started moving real weight.
gymHome.stories3Quote: I train at 07:00 before work. The schedule keeps me honest — and the morning crew keeps me accountable.
gymHome.gymsSubtitle: A hand-picked directory of partner gyms — equipment, atmosphere and standards worth your session.
gymHome.venueIronDesc: A 24/7 strength floor with a full free-weight arsenal and a calm, focused crowd.
gymHome.venuePulseDesc: Bright cardio zones, group classes every day and easy parking in the center.
gymHome.venueVertexDesc: Olympic platforms, professional coaches and a recovery zone for serious athletes.
gymHome.ctaTitle: Your first week is on us.
gymHome.ctaSubtitle: Pick a plan, find your gym and let the work compound. Onboarding and week one are free — no card required.
gymHome.ctaNote: Free onboarding session with every plan.

dietHome.metaDescription: Nutritionist-built meal plans, a chef-crafted recipe library, weekly meal schedules and the finest partner markets and studios.
dietHome.heroSubtitle: Nutritionist-built meal plans, a chef-crafted recipe library and the finest partner markets — composed into one premium nutrition experience.
dietHome.marqueeItems: Protein • Balance • Seasonal • Hydration • Portion • Rhythm
dietHome.whySubtitle: Plans, recipes and shopping composed as one system — so the kitchen finally matches your goals.
dietHome.why1Desc: Your plan sets protein, carbs and fats for your body and goal — then keeps them honest week by week.
dietHome.why2Desc: Recipes follow the market calendar, so every plate is built on produce at its peak.
dietHome.why3Desc: Every dish is tested by chefs and reviewed by nutritionists — flavor first, numbers close behind.
dietHome.why4Desc: Gentle weekly practices — hydration, portions, mindful eating — turn a plan into a lifestyle.
dietHome.plansTitle: Programs with a point of view
dietHome.plansSubtitle: Every plan is built by nutritionists — balanced, measurable and honest about the routine it asks of you.
dietHome.planBalanceDesc: A gentle full reset: three balanced meals a day to rebuild rhythm and energy.
dietHome.planLeanDesc: Four high-protein meals a day, engineered for steady, visible fat loss.
dietHome.planPerformanceDesc: Five precision meals timed around training, for athletes who count everything.
dietHome.recipesSubtitle: Crisp, tested recipes with full macros — from ten-minute bowls to weekend projects.
dietHome.scheduleSubtitle: Every plan ships with a ready weekly menu — swap, repeat or shop it as-is.
dietHome.scheduleRestNote: Sunday is a free table — family dinner, no tracking, no guilt.
dietHome.stories1Quote: The Lean Protocol finally made food feel structured. Eight weeks in, my energy is steady all day — and the recipes are actually good.
dietHome.stories2Quote: Macro targets without preaching. I shop the weekly menu on Saturday and stop thinking about food all week.
dietHome.stories3Quote: Our whole family eats from the same plan now. The chef-level recipes turned Sunday dinner into an event.
dietHome.venuesTitle: Shop and dine at the best tables
dietHome.venuesSubtitle: A hand-picked directory of partner markets, kitchens and bars — standards worth your appetite.
dietHome.venueMarketDesc: An organic market hall with seasonal boxes and produce picked the same morning.
dietHome.venueKitchenDesc: Daily meal-prep with your exact macros on the label — order Sunday, eat all week.
dietHome.venueBarDesc: Cold-pressed juices, vegan bowls and an in-house nutritionist every evening.
dietHome.ctaTitle: Your first meal plan is on us.
dietHome.ctaSubtitle: Pick a plan, shop the menu and let good food compound. Onboarding and week one are free — no card required.
dietHome.ctaNote: Free nutritionist consultation with every plan.

meditationHome.metaDescription: Guided meditation sessions, science-backed programs, certified mentors and a weekly rhythm for a quieter mind.
meditationHome.heroSubtitle: Guided sessions, science-backed programs and certified mentors — composed into one premium practice for a quieter mind.
meditationHome.marqueeItems: Breath • Stillness • Focus • Sleep • Calm • Presence
meditationHome.whySubtitle: Practice, sleep and insight composed as one system — five minutes or a full evening, always guided.
meditationHome.why1Desc: Every program stands on published research in attention, stress and sleep — reviewed by clinical advisors.
meditationHome.why2Desc: Sessions sized for real days: a breath before the meeting, a body scan after work.
meditationHome.why3Desc: Wind-downs, sleep stories and a fourteen-evening reset for the nights that resist.
meditationHome.why4Desc: Streaks, calm minutes and gentle weekly insights — encouragement, never judgment.
meditationHome.plansTitle: Paths with a point of view
meditationHome.plansSubtitle: Every program is structured day by day — short sessions, honest progress and no mysticism.
meditationHome.planFoundationsDesc: Seven days to learn the mechanics of attention — ten minutes every morning.
meditationHome.planFocusDesc: A three-week training block for sustained attention at work and in practice.
meditationHome.planSleepDesc: Fourteen evenings of wind-downs, breath and stories to rebuild your nights.
meditationHome.sessionsSubtitle: Crisp, mentor-verified guidance for the practices that matter most.
meditationHome.scheduleSubtitle: Live sessions are included with every program — just pick a slot and sit down.
meditationHome.scheduleRestNote: Sunday is silence day — one long open sit, no guidance, no timer.
meditationHome.storiesTitle: Calm that keeps people coming back
meditationHome.stories1Quote: Deep Focus carried me through a brutal quarter. Twenty-one days in, my attention stopped leaking everywhere.
meditationHome.stories2Quote: The Sleep Reset ended a decade of 2 a.m. staring. Fourteen evenings — I sleep like it was always easy.
meditationHome.stories3Quote: I sit at 07:00 with the live morning session. The rhythm holds me — and the mentors hold the quality.
meditationHome.mentorsSubtitle: A hand-picked circle of mentors — training, temperament and standards worth your practice.
meditationHome.mentorLeylaDesc: An MBSR teacher with a decade of group practice — calm, precise, quietly funny.
meditationHome.mentorSamirDesc: Breathwork specialist for athletes and founders; sessions built around real schedules.
meditationHome.mentorAidaDesc: Clinical psychologist blending CBT and mindfulness for stress and sleep programs.
meditationHome.ctaTitle: Your first week is on us.
meditationHome.ctaSubtitle: Pick a program, meet a mentor and let the practice compound. Onboarding and week one are free — no card required.
meditationHome.ctaNote: Free intro session with every program.

libraryHome.metaDescription: Curated book collections, fifteen-minute summaries, weekly reading plans and the finest partner reading rooms.
libraryHome.heroSubtitle: Curated collections, fifteen-minute summaries and reading circles — composed into one premium reading experience.
libraryHome.marqueeItems: Reading • Reflection • Practice • Discussion • Collection • Growth
libraryHome.whyTitle: Read what matters, leave the rest
libraryHome.whySubtitle: Collections, summaries and discussion composed as one system — a reading life that survives real weeks.
libraryHome.why1Desc: Every title is chosen by working editors and readers — no algorithms, no padding.
libraryHome.why2Desc: Sharp summaries for every book, so a commute counts as reading when it must.
libraryHome.why3Desc: Small weekly groups with a moderator — books discussed, not just finished.
libraryHome.why4Desc: Notes, highlights and a personal shelf that remembers every line worth keeping.
libraryHome.plansTitle: Shelves with a point of view
libraryHome.plansSubtitle: Every collection is sequenced by editors — progressive, connected and honest about the attention it asks.
libraryHome.colFoundationsDesc: Twenty-four books that build the base: attention, habits, money and meaning.
libraryHome.colMindDesc: Thirty-two titles on how we think, decide and fool ourselves — psychology with teeth.
libraryHome.colLeadershipDesc: Twenty-eight books on leading teams and mastering a craft, from daily practice up.
libraryHome.booksSubtitle: Crisp, editor-verified notes for the titles that anchor every serious shelf.
libraryHome.scheduleSubtitle: Reading plans ship with every collection — twenty minutes a slot, honest pages.
libraryHome.scheduleRestNote: Sunday is a slow-page day — reread a favorite chapter, expect nothing new.
libraryHome.stories1Quote: The Mind & Behavior circle got me reading again after five years. Thirty-two books in — I argue better and sleep fine.
libraryHome.stories2Quote: Summaries on the commute, chapters at night. Twelve weeks and my shelf finally looks like a reader's.
libraryHome.stories3Quote: The moderation is the magic. Our circle argues about one chapter a week — and I remember all of them.
libraryHome.venuesSubtitle: A hand-picked directory of partner libraries and book houses — light, silence and standards worth your hours.
libraryHome.venueNizamiDesc: A heritage book house with rare editions, deep shelves and honest silence.
libraryHome.venuePaperCupDesc: A bright book café — good coffee, weekly author nights and room to spread out.
libraryHome.venueRoomDesc: A classic reading room with member desks, a kids corner and a digital archive.
libraryHome.ctaTitle: Your first month is on us.

libraryHome.ctaNote: Free editor consultation with every collection.
